name: auriga-cli
description: Plugins shipped by the auriga-cli Claude Code harness (workflow skills, git guards, quality-gate scaffolding, notifications).

plugins.name: auriga-workflow
plugins.description: The auriga workflow plugin: workflow skills — systematic-debugging (evidence-first diagnosis), test-driven-development (minimal behavior-first TDD), incremental-impl (implementation slicing), spec-design (requirement clarification), arch-design (architecture design), code-simplify (code simplification), session-compound (session compounding), goalify (autonomous /goal planning), deep-review (multi-dimensional PR review orchestrator), reviewer-creator (custom reviewer scaffolding), git-workflow (git lifecycle skill), documentation-and-adrs (architecture decision records and documentation discipline), docent (single-subagent code-comprehension HTML reports) — plus the git lifecycle hooks that enforce them: commit-reminder, pr-create-guard, pr-ready-guard, pr-merge-guard. Dual-Agent compatible (Claude Code + Codex).

plugins.name: quality-gate-scaffolder
plugins.description: Scaffold stack-specific hard quality gates for Swift iOS, Kotlin Android, Python backend, TypeScript frontend, and Node tool repositories. Each skill separates tools, rules, and invocation timing, and requires explicit confirmation before writing files or changing remote GitHub settings.

plugins.name: auriga-notify
plugins.description: Opt-in macOS native notification hook for Claude Code Notification events.
